question: Should OpenClaw support per-task model hints inside HEARTBEAT.md, fold this need into the cron/job-level model override contract, or keep heartbeat model routing at whole-turn/plugin scope?
rationale: The source gap is real, but choosing a fix changes public HEARTBEAT.md syntax, provider/model precedence, session-state behavior, and the boundary between core config and plugin-owned routing.

options.title: Fold into cron/job overrides
options.body: Use the related scheduled-job model override direction as the general solution for cost-aware periodic work and avoid a heartbeat-only syntax until the scheduler contract settles.

options.title: Add HEARTBEAT.md task hints
options.body: Define model/provider fields on heartbeat task blocks, split due tasks by effective model, and test timestamp/session restoration semantics.

options.title: Keep whole-turn routing
options.body: Document that heartbeat currently has one model-routed turn and route dynamic policy through before_model_resolve plugins unless a missing generic seam is proven.

recommendation.title: Fold into cron/job overrides
recommendation.body: Use the related scheduled-job model override direction as the general solution for cost-aware periodic work and avoid a heartbeat-only syntax until the scheduler contract settles.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent overlap across provider/model routing, config schema, and heartbeat-adjacent runtime seams.
